lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 to 6 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is wider in the mid-section and becomes more compressed toward the posterior boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Most vertical lines exhibit discontinuity; the anterior-most lines terminate mid-flank, while the posterior lines terminate before reaching the ventral hairline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 to 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch and lateral thigh area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns describe a spiral lyrate trajectory, initially diverging laterally from the frontal bone before curving medially and terminating in an upward vertical orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 4.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 12-15% of the total vertical horn length from base to apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic birds (Oxpeckers) located on the mid-dorsal ridge and the posterior rump. A prominent white-haired dorsal crest is visible extending along the spine.
